Tests in RibbonEnterCommitTests: Scale and Angle of the hatch tabs, the Array columns, the Image brightness, the Text Editor height with Esc, the Annotate height and a radius in Properties, each with a real box in the laid-out workspace; a scan of every box of the ribbons, the Text Editor, Insert, Annotate and View tabs that fails for a box that neither says so nor writes at each keystroke.
**NEW.** The font boxes show a TrueType family's other names after its English one, as the maintainer asked (`TT  DotumChe  돋움체`, `TT  Malgun Gothic  맑은 고딕`, `TT  MS Gothic  ＭＳ ゴシック`; `TT  Arial` stays alone, SHX fonts are unchanged). The names come from the font's own name table (family name 1 and the typographic family name 16, in every language), read in the scan of the Fonts folders that already reads each file, in the order of their language ids with the English ones and repeats left out: `CadTrueTypeFonts.LocalNamesOf` (new). The Text Style dialog's Font name box, the MTEXT editor's font box and the font column of the dialog's style list show them in muted words after the name, trimmed with an ellipsis where they do not fit, all of them in the tooltip; the Missing Fonts dialog shows a family it lacks as the drawing stores it. The list stays sorted by the English name and the value a style stores is unchanged: picking a font stores its English family, and a style that stores `맑은 고딕` keeps it, byte for byte, after Apply. Typing in the Text Style box finds a font by the start of any of its names (`dot` or `돋` finds DotumChe, `맑` finds Malgun Gothic): the `FontSearch` attached property matches each name on its own, since the box's own text search takes one text per entry. The first scan of 1 324 families went from 204 to 245 ms in a console probe (the Text Style dialog's first open, 1.75 s, did not change within noise).
**FIXED.** The Text Style dialog showed an empty Font name box for a style whose font the machine does not have (the maintainer's pictures: 0-BIM-TEXT of DotumChe, a Korean family not installed, against AutoCAD, which shows 돋움체), and merely showing such a style, or pressing Apply after it, rewrote it. The box was bound to the font by name; a style whose family was not in the list had it added by a second list handed to the box, which cleared the selection and pushed a blank back, so the dialog took the style as changed (the footer said "Unsaved changes to 0-BIM-TEXT. Apply redraws the 26 texts that use it" before anything was touched) and Apply wrote it as an SHX style of the file `dotumche.ttf`, its typeface, bold and italic flags and Korean character set (129) gone. The box now always shows the style's own font, in the list as the style stores it, marked `(not installed)` for a TrueType family and `(not found)` for an SHX file the font folders lack; a family stored under a localized name the system knows another way (`맑은 고딕`, installed as Malgun Gothic) selects the installed entry; the Big font box does the same for a big font no folder has; and showing a style never marks it changed, whatever it holds: a style drawn from a font file alone, a typeface with its character set, a big font on a TrueType style, a height of 2.123456 or a width of 0.123456789 come back as they are stored (a drawing of ten styles, each shown and Apply pressed: its text identical to the byte, none marked changed). A real edit (a width factor, bold, another font) still marks the style changed and keeps the font it was not asked to change. The list of SHX fonts is the folders of Folder preference and the `Fonts` folder beside `GeometryHelper.Cad.dll`, no longer the drawing's own folder, which is not looked in; the hint under the box says so.
**FIXED.** The MTEXT editor's font box was empty where the letters under the caret were in a font the list lacks: a family this machine has not (`\fGhNoSuchFontFamily|b0|i0|c129|p34;`), or a font code in other letters than the list spells it (`\fARIAL`). The box lists the font after the style's while the caret is in it, and shows the listed spelling.
**NEW.** Default support folders, as AutoCAD has its Fonts and Support folders: `Fonts`, `Hatches` and `Linetypes` next to `GeometryHelper.Cad.dll` (the dll's folder, not the exe's, so an app that embeds the dll, such as a model drawing app, finds them). They ship with the presenter, reach the output of every project that uses it, and hold a `README.txt` each; `Hatches` holds `GeometryHelper.pat` (the 48 built-in patterns) and `Linetypes` holds `GeometryHelper.lin` (the 39 built-in linetypes), written in AutoCAD's `.pat` and `.lin` formats from the built-in definitions as models for your own files (a test keeps them equal to the sets; the name `GeometryHelper.pat` or `.lin` still always means the built-in set). Put SHX fonts and big fonts, `.ttf`, `.ttc` and `.otf` files, `.pat` files and `.lin` files there and they are found by name. A font, a pattern file or a linetype file is looked for in three places, in this order: the folders set in Global settings > Folder preference, the default folder next to the dll, then the built-in font, patterns and linetypes; a folder that does not exist is passed over without a word. TrueType fonts installed in Windows are found first, as before (by family through the canvas, a style's `.ttf` file name through the Windows Fonts folder); for a typeface Windows does not have, a `.ttf`, `.ttc` or `.otf` file of that family in those folders is drawn instead, with no installing, and the family is not listed as missing (the regular face is preferred to a bold or italic one; a folder's file list is read at each look and a file's family names once). New `CadSupportFolders` and `CadSupportKind`. Folder preference shows the default folders as read-only rows marked "(default)" with their full path ("not found" where missing) and an Open folder button, never saved into the settings file, and a line under each list that says the order.
**CHANGED.** The folder of the drawing is no longer looked in for fonts (SHX and TrueType files), hatch pattern files (`.pat`) or linetype files (`.lin`): the maintainer found it confusing. Put them in a folder of Folder preference or in the default folders next to the dll. Xrefs and images are still found relative to the drawing. The test `AFontIsLookedForInTheDrawingsFolderFirstThenInTheFoldersInOrder_OfAnyCase` is now `AFontIsLookedForInTheFoldersInOrder_OfAnyCase_AndNotInTheDrawingsFolder`.
**BREAKING.** The AutoCAD-like presenter projects are renamed: `GeometryHelper.Dxf.Viewer` is now `GeometryHelper.Cad`, `GeometryHelper.Dxf.Viewer.Wpf` is `GeometryHelper.Cad.Wpf`, and the app `GeometryHelper.Dxf.App` is `GeometryHelper.Cad.App` (the exe is `GeometryHelper.Cad.App.exe`). The projects, folders, assemblies and root namespaces follow, and so do the tests and samples (`GeometryHelper.Cad.UnitTest`, `GeometryHelper.Cad.Wpf.UnitTest`, `GeometryHelper.Cad.Plugins.UnitTest`, `GeometryHelper.Cad.Plugins.Net8Runner`, `GeometryHelper.Cad.SamplePlugin`). Every namespace `GeometryHelper.Dxf.Viewer[.X]` becomes `GeometryHelper.Cad[.X]` and `GeometryHelper.Dxf.Viewer.Wpf[.X]` becomes `GeometryHelper.Cad.Wpf[.X]`; code that used the DXF types through the parent namespace now needs `using GeometryHelper.Dxf;`. A plugin built against the old assemblies must be rebuilt against `GeometryHelper.Cad`. Nothing else changes: the DXF and DWG reader and writer keep the namespace `GeometryHelper.Dxf`, `GeometryHelper.CadConvert` keeps its name, and the settings folder `%AppData%\GeometryHelper\Drawing` and every settings key are unchanged.
**CHANGED.** The presenter's app is called GeometryHelper CAD, no longer GeometryHelper DXF, to match its new project names and the DWG drawings it opens: the title bar ("GeometryHelper CAD  plan.dxf"), the start screen, "Exit GeometryHelper CAD", the file type Explorer shows ("Drawing (GeometryHelper CAD)", written the next time the association is set) and the guides. Its folder of plugins and recent files stays `%AppData%GeometryHelperDxf`, so nothing kept there is lost.
**FIXED.** MOVE of a viewport of a layout showed no preview at its second point (the maintainer's picture): only the rubber band ran from the base point, and neither the frame nor the model shown in it followed the cursor, where AutoCAD 2021 drags both. The ghost a transforming command draws (`CadGhost`) outlined every kind of display item but a viewport, so a viewport among the objects contributed nothing; and the previews that edit a copy of the object (STRETCH, the grips) drew a viewport copy as nothing too, because the builder of a preview has no model space for it to show. The ghost now draws the frame, or the outline of a clipped viewport, and the model through it in the model's own colours, cut to the frame, as the edit will leave them: MOVE and COPY carry the model with the frame, ROTATE turns the view by the angle, MIRROR puts the frame's centre at its mirror image, SCALE scales the frame about the base point and leaves the model standing still on the sheet, each worked out by the rules the edit itself follows (`CadViewportPreview.After`; tests compare it with what MOVE, SCALE, ROTATE and MIRROR then leave, for a viewport twisted 0 and 30 degrees, clipped or not). STRETCH shows the frame resized with the model still, and a corner grip clicked (`** STRETCH **`, which had no preview for any object but a dynamic block's custom grip) shows the same, the middle grip the frame moved with its model; a viewport clipped by an entity is previewed only together with its boundary, as the edit moves it (alone it stays where it is). The outlines of the model are made once for a drag and drawn moved by a transformation of the screen: in the offscreen canvas of the tests, a cursor move costs 0.1 ms of recording for 1 000 lines in view, 1.0 ms for 20 000 and 4.2 ms for 100 000 (the whole canvas drawn by the software renderer of `RenderTargetBitmap` takes 13, 130 and 730 ms a move against about 10 ms without the preview; not measured on a real window, which WPF draws on the graphics card), and over 50 000 outlines in view only the frame follows the cursor. The preview of PASTECLIP at `Specify insertion point` drew nothing for a viewport copied from a layout either (the paste looked for its objects in model space of the clipboard, where a viewport is not, and the builder drew a viewport at its old place): it now shows the frame and the model of the drawing it goes into at the cursor, and the objects of a layout that hold no model-space object are previewed too.
**FIXED.** Resizing a viewport's frame moved the model inside it on the sheet: the corner grip kept the view's centre, so the content stayed centred in the new frame (a viewport 200 by 100 at 1:50 showing (1 000, 500), its lower right corner dragged 30 right and 30 down, showed its drawing 15 right and 15 up of where it had been). In AutoCAD 2021 (probed in its console, the view twisted 0 and 30 degrees alike) a resize leaves the model standing still and changes only the window onto it, the scale kept, the view's centre moved by the step of the frame's centre over the scale: that frame is 230 by 130 about (165, 85), the view's centre (1 750, -250), 6 500 high, and a point of the drawing is where it was to a millionth. The corner grip, STRETCH and SCALE all do so now, through one `DxfViewport` step (`FitFrame`, the one `FitToClip` already used for a clipped viewport's boundary). SCALE of a viewport that is not clipped used the library's `TransformBy`, which keeps the view and so changed its scale (by 2 the viewport showed the same part of model space twice as large); the command now scales the frame and the view's height alike, as AutoCAD's does (400 by 200, 10 000 high, the view's centre moved by the step of the frame's centre; about the frame's own centre it stays). `DxfEntity.TransformBy` is unchanged: it is AutoCAD's `Entity.TransformBy`, which does keep the view. MOVE, COPY and a window holding all four corners still carry the content with the frame, and the Width and Height of the Properties keep the centre, so the model stays.
**NEW.** STRETCH takes a viewport's frame: a crossing window about one corner, or the two corners of a side, resizes it, as AutoCAD's does (before, such a window did nothing to a viewport).
**FIXED.** A double click inside a viewport of a layout worked through it (MSPACE) only where the first click had landed on the frame: the first click on empty paper inside the viewport starts the implied window of `Select objects:` (a command, SELECT, which runs), and the second click found a command running and left the double click alone, so it only ended the box and nothing was entered. Hits came by chance on the frame's edge, the one place a click picks the viewport and opens no box. The second click now ends the implied window and works through the viewport, nothing selected, wherever it lies inside the frame or the outline of a clipped viewport (tested at six spots, near the four corners, the left side and the middle, and on the edge), and a double click off every frame while working through goes back to the paper the same way; a command that really runs (LINE at its first point) still takes the clicks as points, and a paper object under the cursor still takes the double click. New `CadCommandSession.IsImpliedWindow`.
**FIXED.** A viewport on a layer switched off or frozen could still be worked through (double click, MSPACE, Ctrl+R) though it is not drawn and shows nothing; `EnterableViewports` and `EnterViewport` now leave it out, as AutoCAD works through none it does not show. A layer set not to plot changes nothing.
**FIXED.** Object snaps could not reach what a viewport shows. On the paper no snap went through a viewport: a paper LINE or dimension asked for a point at the end of a model line seen in the viewport (3 000, 2 500 shown at (200, 150)) and got the cursor 1.04 away from it instead of the endpoint, and the frame of the viewport itself had no corner, midpoint or side to snap to. The paper now snaps to the model space a viewport shows (endpoint, midpoint, centre, quadrant, intersection, nearest and the rest of the snaps that are on), the aperture in the viewport's scale, the point mapped by its view, scale and twist, only inside the frame or the clip outline of the viewport and never on a layer frozen in it, the nearer of that and a paper object's snap taken; and to the corners, midpoints and sides of a viewport's frame. Worked through a viewport, the snaps of model space no longer reach the layers frozen in that viewport (they are not shown). The snap through a viewport names no object, so a dimension placed that way is not associated with the model object (AutoCAD's trans-spatial association, DIMASSOC 2, is not made); the object snaps typed at a prompt and the acquired points of object snap tracking (OTRACK) work on the paper's own objects alone. Tests in CanvasViewportSnapTests, CanvasViewportDoubleClickTests and CanvasViewportClipTests.
**NEW.** Opening a drawing now tells you about TrueType fonts the machine has not, not only missing SHX files. The Missing SHX files dialog gains a second, read-only list, Missing TrueType fonts: each family (or `.ttf`/`.ttc`/`.otf` file name) a text style names, or an MTEXT's `\f` code names (the MTEXTs of model space, layouts and blocks; those inside dimensions, leaders and attributes are not read), that the machine does not have, listed once whatever its case, in the order of the names, with what it is drawn in: `DotumChe` is `Arial, letters it lacks from another font` (Arial is the drawing font of Global settings; a letter it lacks comes from the first of Segoe UI, Tahoma and Times New Roman that has it, else the font Windows links for it). A TrueType font has no replacement to choose. The dialog is titled Missing Fonts when TrueType rows are present and keeps Missing SHX files when only SHX files are missing; a drawing whose only missing fonts are TrueType opens it with the TrueType list alone. A family the machine has under a local name (`맑은 고딕` for Malgun Gothic) is not listed. `CadDocument.FindMissingTrueTypeFonts()` gives the list.
**FIXED.** Global settings had no way to turn the Missing SHX files dialog back on once its Do not show again was ticked. Text and fonts › Font not found now has the switch Show the missing fonts dialog on opening a drawing, bound to `ShowMissingShxDialog` (still saved as `showMissingShxDialog`).
**FIXED.** The Name column of the Layer manager grew wider and wider while the list was scrolled, and the header and the rows lost their alignment (a drawing of 367 layers: the Name column was 169 wide at the top, 897 after one row was scrolled and 1 491 further down, pushing every other column to the right, and it never shrank back). The table sits in a sideways ScrollViewer, which measures its content at infinite width, so each row sized the star-width Name column to its own name and the list took the width of the longest name it had realized. The table now takes the width of the viewport (or its minimum), every column is a fixed width, and the Name column is the same for the header and every row (`LayerManagerViewModel.NameWidth`, 140 at first); a longer name is cut with an ellipsis and shown in full as a tooltip, and the right edge of the Name head resizes the column (80 to 600). The header also sat wider than the rows by the list's scroll bar, so its columns were never over theirs; both now start at the same place and keep their columns. The preview of Layer Filter Properties had the same shift (its rows 6 pixels in, its star columns 12 pixels narrower beside the scroll bar), now gone: its Name column is a fixed 200 with a tooltip and its rows have no inset of their own. `LayerManagerViewModel.TableMinWidth` is 1 094 (1 822 with the VP columns) with the default Name, it was 1 090 (1 820).
**FIXED.** A crosshair size of 100 % (Global settings, CURSORSIZE 100) did not reach the edges of the canvas: each line was half the canvas's larger side long from the cursor, so with the cursor near the lower right of a canvas of 1000 by 670 the horizontal line began about 180 pixels in from the left edge and the vertical one about 70 below the top. At 100 the lines now run from edge to edge of the canvas whatever the cursor position, turned by SNAPANG or an isometric snap too, and through a viewport of a layout they stop at its frame, as AutoCAD 2021 draws them; below 100 they are the same share of the larger side as before. Tests in CrosshairSizeTests.
**FIXED.** The Korean lines of an MTEXT drew as question marks ("???? ??? ????") where the Vietnamese lines beside them drew right. The style 0-BIM-TEXT of the drawing names DotumChe, a Korean family the machine has not (Dotum, DotumChe and Gulim come with a Korean Windows, not with this one: Malgun Gothic, MS Gothic and SimSun are installed), and a font not found is drawn in the replacement font, FONTALT, whose default is GeometryHelper Simplex, a single-stroke font with 98 Latin letters and no Hangul. A TrueType family or file not found is now drawn in a TrueType font, the drawing font (Arial by default), as AutoCAD draws it through the font mapping of Windows, so a letter Arial lacks comes out of the font Windows links for it: the Hangul of "한글 도면" are drawn from Malgun Gothic, and the same text in a style of Arial is the same picture, pixel for pixel (a test compares them). The replacement font stays for an SHX font not found (romans.shx), and one set to a TrueType font is still used. The style keeps its own name (the Properties panel and STYLE read the drawing's DotumChe) and the command line says `Font DotumChe not found: using the drawing font.` once. Families are matched by any of their names already, English or local (SkiaSharp asks DirectWrite: `맑은 고딕` is Malgun Gothic, `ＭＳ ゴシック` MS Gothic, `宋体` SimSun on this machine), so no table of names was added.
**FIXED.** The selection box at the top of the Properties palette did not drop down: it was a label with a chevron drawn beside it, so seven objects, five MTEXTs and two OLE frames, showed `All (7)` and only the General rows with nothing to choose. It is a list now, as AutoCAD 2021's is: `All (7)`, then one row for each kind of object with its count in the order of the kinds' names (`MText (5)`, `OLE Object (2)`); choosing a kind shows the properties of its objects alone, as though only they were selected (the Text and Geometry groups of the five MTEXTs), and every edit reaches those objects and no other of the seven, as one undo step, while the drawing's selection stays all seven; `All (7)` returns to the common rows. The list is rebuilt as the selection changes and the box returns to All. The Quick Properties panel has the same list and edits the kind chosen. `CadProperties.Kinds(document, handles)` and `CadSelectionKind` give the rows; `MainViewModel.SelectionKinds` and `SelectedKind` are the box's list and choice.
**NEW.** The buttons beside the selection box of the Properties palette, which the presenter lacked: Toggle value of PICKADD (switches PICKADD between 1 and 0, shown pressed while it is 1), Select Objects (the new SELECT command: `Select objects:`, and the objects picked become the selection, no undo step) and Quick Select (QSELECT).
**FIXED.** STRETCH drew a dashed amber line from the first corner to the cursor at `Specify opposite corner:`, where AutoCAD 2021 draws the box of `Select objects:` (the maintainer's picture). The canvas draws a band only for a prompt that carries one (`CadPrompt.Band`), and STRETCH's own corner and CP prompts carried none, so it fell back on the rubber band of the base point. They now carry it: a box (blue and solid dragged left to right, green and dashed right to left, or the window or crossing that W or C typed makes) and the polygon of CP through its points. The same fault was in the crossing box and the fence of TRIM and EXTEND (the fence drew only its last segment), which now draw their box and their line through every point; and in every other prompt that asks the opposite corner of a box from a first corner (ZOOM Window, the windows of PLOT, EXPORT and the PDF output, the rectangle of IMAGECLIP, MVIEW, the unit cell of ARRAY and MINSERT, the stretch frame of the Block Editor), which draw the rectangle of the two corners and no line.
**FIXED.** A hatch whose pattern comes to many short lines drew nothing inside its boundary: the display drew only the boundary of a hatch of more than 20 000 pattern lines, and a rectangle 1000 by 500 of a millimetre drawing hatched with CROSS at scale 1 (a dash of 3.175 and a gap of 3.175 every 6.35, both ways) comes to 24 806 lines. Over that rectangle 16 of the presenter's own patterns drew nothing at scale 1: DOTS (197 820 lines), HEX (57 512), HONEY (57 421), SQUARE (49 612), ZIGZAG (49 571), TRIANG (42 853), EARTH (37 337), ISO07W100 (33 066), ANSI36 (28 567), CROSS (24 806), DASH (24 746), AR-SAND (23 902), ANGLE, ANSI33, INSUL and ISO14W100. The limit is now 250 000 lines, so every one of them draws its lines (a test hatches the rectangle with each of the 48 patterns); a hatch past 250 000 lines is still drawn by its boundary. Probed in AutoCAD 2021's console: its HATCH makes DOTS and CROSS at scale 1 over the rectangle and refuses a pattern too dense with `Hatch spacing too dense, or dash size too small.` and no hatch (lines of its own 0.03 apart, CROSS of acad.pat at scale 0.1); the presenter's HATCH does not refuse one yet.
**FIXED.** While a dimension was placed (DIMLINEAR at `Specify dimension line location`, and DIMALIGNED, DIMANGULAR, DIMRADIUS, DIMDIAMETER, DIMORDINATE, DIMBASELINE, DIMCONTINUE and the rest, which share the canvas's preview), the preview drew the measured value as an empty rectangle, the box of its words, where the finished dimension shows the number. The canvas drew every text of a preview that is not an SHX font by its box (the way the ghost of MOVE draws a text) and a dimension's words, an MTEXT, are TrueType. It now draws them as the letters of their font, filled, laid out as the finished text is (place, turn, height, width factor, slant, alignment, lines, the faces a missing letter falls back to), each run of an MTEXT in its own colour; QTEXTMODE 1 still shows the box. A DIMLINEAR of 0,500 to 4000,500 at DIMSCALE 40 has 0 inked pixels inside the box of its "4000" in the preview before, 268 after (6 cases tested: DIMLINEAR, DIMALIGNED, DIMRADIUS, DIMDIAMETER, DIMANGULAR, DIMORDINATE). The ghost of MOVE, COPY and the like still draws a text by its box.
**FIXED.** The preview of a dimension style in the Dimension Style Manager, the New and Modify dialogs and the Purge dialog was unreadable for a style with an overall scale (DIMSCALE 25, words and arrowheads 2.5): its sample part, 32 by 20 with a circle of radius 12, was drawn at that size while the scale made the words and arrowheads 25 times bigger, so "32" and "R12" lay over a tiny sample. The sample is now drawn DIMSCALE times bigger, as AutoCAD's is (DIMSCALE 0 taken for 1): at DIMSCALE 25 the part is 800 by 500, the circle 300 in radius, the words read "800" and "R300", and the picture of 256 by 164 has 1998 inked pixels before the change against 1379 at DIMSCALE 1, and 1406 after.
**CHANGED.** The Manage tab of the presenter no longer has the greyed Action Recorder panel (Record, Play, Manage Action Macros), and the canvas's right-click Default menu no longer has the greyed Action Recorder submenu (Play, Record, Stop): the recorder will not be built, so a button that could never be pressed was only noise. Manage now begins with Customization; the Default menu runs from SteeringWheels straight to Convert PS to MS.
**CHANGED.** Autosave writes one copy of a drawing, over and over, in place of the numbered copies that grew. `plan.dxf` is autosaved as `plan.autosave.dxf` and `plan.dwg` as `plan.dwg.autosave.dxf` (the DWG's extension is kept in the name so that `plan.dxf` beside it has a copy of its own); before, each autosave pushed the last down the line, `plan.dwg.autosave1.dxf`, `autosave2.dxf`, `autosave3.dxf`, three files of 14 MB for a drawing of 14 MB. Global settings, Save and export, Saving has a new **Autosave format**, DXF (the default) or DWG, kept in the settings file as `saveAndExport.autosaveFormat`: DWG writes `plan.autosave.dwg` with the presenter's DWG writer, in the version the drawing was last saved as, or AutoCAD 2018 for a drawing never saved as a DWG (a drawing the DWG writer refuses gets no copy that time, and the log says so). **Backups kept** is removed from Global settings and from `GlobalSettings` (`BackupsKept`): it only said how many numbered copies autosave kept, which there is no longer a use for, and a settings file that still has `backupsKept` is read without it. The numbered copies older versions left are not written or deleted any more: the Drawing Recovery Manager (DRAWINGRECOVERY) still lists and opens them, after the one copy of their drawing, and the copies of both kinds, DXF and DWG, are kept out of the Drawings list.
**FIXED.** Import acad.pgp... on Global settings' Shortcuts page left Apply and OK greyed after an import that had changed things ("acad.pgp: 25 aliases added, 6 changed, 254 unchanged; 120 skipped..."), so it could not be saved. AutoCAD 2021's acad.pgp has `DXFOUT, *SAVEAS`, and DXFOUT is a command of the presenter of its own; a name wins over an alias where a word is typed, so the alias could never be used, and the page marked SAVEAS red ("DXFOUT is the name of a command"), which keeps Apply and OK off for as long as a row is in red. The import now leaves out an alias that is the name of another command of the app and says so in the footer ("...; 1 alias left out, the name of a command"); with AutoCAD 2021's acad.pgp nothing is left in red and Apply and OK are on.
**FIXED.** The "..." button beside Format in Modify Table Style (and Data Format > Custom Table Cell Format of the Table Cell tab) answered `'Resources' property has already been set on 'DataFormatWindow'` and opened nothing. The window's XAML put a `ResourceDictionary Source=` and a converter side by side as the window's Resources, which WPF reads as the property set twice; the dictionary is now merged (`ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries`) as the other windows do. No other XAML file of the presenter had the pattern: a test reads every one, and a second builds 74 of the windows as their callers do.
**FIXED.** Objects selected before a command are taken by the commands that start with `Select objects:`, as AutoCAD 2021 takes them (PICKFIRST 1), for the commands that ignored them: a line selected and then LAYISO now isolates its layer at once (`1 found`, `Layer "Steel" has been isolated.`) instead of asking `Select objects on the layer(s) to be isolated:`. Probed one command at a time in AutoCAD 2021's console (the selection set with SSSETFIRST, kept by not leading the next line with Esc, which clears it: the notes that said the console takes no selection were the Esc). New in the presenter: LAYISO, STRETCH (moved whole, no window asked), JOIN, BURST, TXTEXP, TXT2MTXT, JUSTIFYTEXT and SCALETEXT (the texts of the selection counted: `2 found` of nine), TEXTALIGN, DIMDISASSOCIATE and DIMREASSOCIATE (the dimensions counted), MLEADERALIGN, MLEADERCOLLECT, STLOUT, TRANSPARENCY, IMAGEADJUST and PDFADJUST (`0 found` of a line, then `Select image(s):`), OBJECTSCALE, -OBJECTSCALE, AIOBJECTSCALEADD, AIOBJECTSCALEREMOVE, DELCONSTRAINT, DCDISPLAY and CONSTRAINTBAR, and, for one object, PEDIT (a line too), SPLINEDIT, HATCHEDIT and TEXTEDIT when exactly one object is selected. TRIM and EXTEND take it as the cutting or boundary edges in Standard mode (`Select cutting edges ...`, `2 found`). The commands that took it before now write `N found` where AutoCAD does (ERASE, MOVE, COPY, ROTATE, SCALE, MIRROR, EXPLODE, ARRAY, CHANGE, CHPROP, GROUP and the others) and nothing where it does not (ALIGN, DRAWORDER, MIRROR3D, RESETBLOCK); GROUP and the commands that took the selection their own way clear the grips when they end. See "Selecting first" in the guide.
**CHANGED.** REGION, UNION, INTERSECT and MASSPROP no longer take objects selected before them: AutoCAD 2021's console asks `Select objects:` with a circle or a region selected (REGION, UNION, INTERSECT, MASSPROP all probed), as it does for the commands that pick one object (LAYOFF, LAYFRZ, LAYLCK, LAYULK, FILLET, OFFSET, BREAK, DIVIDE, MEASURE, TRIM and EXTEND in Quick mode).
**FIXED.** A DWG opened in the presenter showed none of its OLE pictures. The DWG reader left every OLE2FRAME out with the types not read yet (a drawing of AutoCAD 2010 with 17 bitmaps pasted: `types that are not read yet were left out: OLE2FRAME 17`), so a drawing AutoCAD shows with its pictures opened with none. The reader now gives each frame as the DXF of AutoCAD writes it: the binary (the head of 128 bytes with the four corners, then the compound file) in the groups 310, the corners as 10 and 11, the kind and user type from the compound file, the space and the plot quality; the 17 frames come out as static bitmaps (Picture (Device Independent Bitmap), 0.4 to 6 MB each), drawn by the same display as a frame of a DXF. The DWG writer writes an OLE2FRAME too, to every version it knows, so a frame made with `new DxfOle2Frame(bitmap)` survives a save as DWG.
**FIXED.** A DWG of AutoCAD 2007 or later made with a double-byte code page in its header (ANSI_949 Korean, ANSI_932, ANSI_936, ANSI_950) had its long texts (an MTEXT of more than 250 bytes) cut inside a letter of UTF-8 by the DWG-to-DXF transcode, which cut after every second byte of a letter of three; opening the file said `The file is of R2007 or later so its text is UTF-8, but some of its bytes are not` and the cut letters were read as U+FFFD (a Korean MTEXT of 300 letters lost one letter at each of its three joins). The pieces are now cut at letter boundaries whatever the code page (`DwgDxfWriter.WriteChunks`).
**FIXED.** The Vietnamese letters of U+1EA0 to U+1EF9 (ạ ả ấ ầ ẩ ẫ ậ ... ỗ ... ỹ) of an MTEXT were drawn as boxes. AutoCAD writes the letters its font lacks as a run of another font: "Lỗi pick" is `L{\fGulim|b0|i0|c129|p50;ỗ}i pick`, and Gulim, like Malgun Gothic, a Korean font, has no glyph for them, so the canvas drew the box of the font's missing glyph (the letters in Latin-1 or Latin Extended, such as ê ư à é, drew). A letter a TrueType font has no glyph for is now drawn from a font that has it, as AutoCAD draws it through the font linking of Windows, on the screen, on a plot and in a PDF (`SkiaCanvasRenderer`) and in the outlines of TXTEXP (`CadTextOutlines`): Arial, Segoe UI, Tahoma and Times New Roman are tried in that order, in the face's bold and italic, then the font Windows gives the letter; a letter none has stays the font's box, and ASCII, spaces and symbol fonts such as Wingdings are never moved. The width of such a letter in the layout is the width of the letter drawn (`SkiaCanvasRenderer.MeasureWidth`). Text whose letters the font has is drawn as before, pixel for pixel. The in-place MTEXT editor already showed them (WPF falls back by itself).
**FIXED.** Preview… of the Plot dialog (and of Page Setup) made the next OK close the app with `DialogResult can be set only after Window is created and shown as dialog`. The dialog hid itself while the preview was open (`Visibility.Hidden`), and WPF ends the ShowDialog of a window that is hidden: the dialog came back as an ordinary window, and OK, or Plot in the preview, set the DialogResult of a window that was no dialog any more. The dialog stays shown under the preview, which is modal and covers it anyway. New public `PlotDialogViewModel.ShowPreview`, the window's way of showing the preview.
**NEW.** A crash log in the apps: an exception nobody caught is written to `%AppData%\GeometryHelper\Drawing\crash.log` (time, version, handler, the command run last, the exception with its stack and inner exceptions; cut at 256 KB to `crash.old.log`) and to `GeometryHelperLog`. An exception of the window's thread shows `An error occurred: <message>. Details were written to <path>. The drawing is kept; save your work.` and the app goes on; an unobserved task exception is written and observed; out of memory and native faults are written and still end the app, and a stack overflow cannot be caught and leaves no entry. See the Crashes and the crash log section of the app guide.
**FIXED.** The presenter closed at once (a stack overflow) when a pattern was chosen in the pattern box of the Hatch Editor tab or the Hatch Creation tab (ANSI31 to CROSS on a hatch of a rectangle), and the same for the Layer box and the Transparency box of the two tabs. The tab told its controls every value had changed after each edit and gave a new list of patterns, layers or transparencies at each reading; the box took the new list as a choice of the user, chose its item again, and that ran the edit again, until the stack ended. What a control answers while the tab tells its values is now let go, so a choice runs one edit and returns. The Image, PDF Underlay, Array and Table Cell tabs were checked the same way, each control once, and had no such loop.
**NEW.** An external reference edited in place in the presenter (REFEDIT, -REFEDIT, REFSET, REFCLOSE, and Edit Xref In-place in the object menu of one external reference, which was grey). The objects of the model space of the drawing the reference names are copied into the drawing where the reference draws them (the drawing itself is only read; the references of its file draw it without them while the edit lasts), edited with every command, and REFCLOSE Save writes them back into the reference's own file, DWG or DXF, whole and in the version the file had (a DWG of AC1027 stays AC1027), with the objects that were not in the working set, its layers and its blocks as they were; the file is written beside itself first and moved over the old one. A reference nested in the file is edited through the one that names it (`SITE > INNER`, writing the file of INNER). With "Enable unique layer and symbol names" on (the default) the layer WALL is `$0$WALL` in the drawing while the edit lasts and WALL again in the file; `SITE|WALL` and `$0$WALL` of an object added with REFSET go back to WALL, a layer of the drawing the added objects stand on is added to the file and listed (`The following symbols will be added to Xref file:`, `Layers: FOO`), and AutoCAD's lines follow (`1 xref instance updated`, `SITE redefined and reloaded.`). Every message is from the string table of AutoCAD 2021's AcRefEdRes.dll: `Selected Xref Block is NOT editable: path`, `Xref may have changed and must be reloaded: path` (with `Reload the Xref [Ok/Cancel] <Ok>:`), `Xref cannot be checked out for editing:` for a file with a `.dwl` beside it, `** Failed to Saveback Xref file **` for a file that is gone, read only or changed since the edit began (the edit stays open to be saved again or discarded), and the notice that a file of an older release is saved in its own release. Discard leaves the file byte for byte as it was. A DWG saved by the presenter was opened in AutoCAD 2021's accoreconsole in AC1027 and AC1032: AUDIT 0 errors, the circle moved 50 up at (50, 80) and the line added on `SITE|FOO` in the xref block. Once the file is written, undo stops where the edit closed.
**NEW.** The Reference Edit dialog of REFEDIT in the presenter's window (REFEDIT; -REFEDIT and a window-less REFEDIT ask on the command line as before): Identify Reference lists the references the point reaches, a block or an external reference, nested ones indented, with the path of the file of the one chosen, and Automatically select all nested objects or Prompt to select nested objects; Settings has Enable unique layer and symbol names (`CadDocument.RefEditUniqueNames`, new, on by default), Display attribute definitions for editing and Lock objects not in working set. `CadRefEditRequest`, `CadRefEditLevel.IsExternalReference` and `FileName`, and `CadRefEdit.IsExternalReference`, `XrefFile` and `FormatNotice` are new.
**CHANGED.** REFEDIT of an external reference no longer says `External references cannot be edited in place in this version.`: it opens the edit (above), or says why the reference is not editable. An INSERT of a block the drawing does not have says `Object is not a valid reference`.
**NEW.** The canvas menus' items that said "Not built yet." and the commands now exist for are wired in the presenter. Convert PS to MS (Convert MS to PS on the paper) of the Default menu starts CHSPACE; the hatch menu's Set Boundary and Generate Boundary start HATCHSETBOUNDARY and HATCHGENERATEBOUNDARY on the hatch selected; Dimension Style gains Save as New Style... (-DIMSTYLE Restore of the one dimension, then Save asking the name on the command line) and Other... (a menu of the styles beyond the first six). Edit Constraint starts -PARAMETERS on the name of the dimensional constraint the dimension shows and leaves `Enter expression:` to be typed (a line of 10 given 25 is 25 long), and Dimension Name Format (Value, Name, Name and Expression) gives the constraints selected the words `10.0000`, `d1` or `d1=10.0000`, one undo step; both are grey, with the reason, for a dimension that is no constraint. What stays grey says why in its tooltip instead of "Not built yet.": image Clip for several images (IMAGECLIP clips one), Table Style's Save as New Table Style... and Set As Table in Current Table Style (a table style keeps no starting table), Synchronize Multiple-scale Positions, the table cell menu's Data Link, Manage Content and Quick Properties, and the two Allow items of Bullets and Numbering.
**NEW.** The search box of the presenter's title bar ("Type a keyword or phrase") lists the commands and variables whose name or description holds the words typed, as the application menu's search does, in a list under the box; Enter or a click starts the first one or the one clicked and empties the box, Esc empties it. New public `MainViewModel.TitleSearchText`, `IsTitleSearching`, `TitleSearchResults` and `RunTitleSearchResult`.
**NEW.** The % button (Insert field) of the Attribute Definition dialog (the Default), the Enhanced Attribute Editor (the Value) and the Edit Attribute dialog of the Block Attribute Manager (the Default) shows the Field dialog and puts the field in its markers at the caret of the box; the attribute or its definition written holds a field of its text, showing what it comes to (`%<\AcVar Date \f "dd/MM/yyyy">%` shows the day), and typing plain words over a text that held a field takes the field away.
**NEW.** The Geometric and Dimensional panels of the Block Editor tab start the constraint commands on the block's objects: Auto Constrain (AUTOCONSTRAIN), Linear (DCLINEAR), Delete (DELCONSTRAINT) and the Parameter Manager (PARAMETERS); the constraints of a block are kept in it and saved with it (a line of 100 by 10 made level by GCHORIZONTAL in the editor, BSAVE and BEDIT again, still has its constraint). Block Table and Construction stay grey, with the reason.
**NEW.** The "Open in block editor" box of the Block Definition dialog (BLOCK) is live: once the block is made, the Block Editor opens on it (BLOCK that asks the base point or the objects on the canvas opens it when it has ended). New public `CadBlockDefinitionRequest.OpenInBlockEditor`.
**NEW.** Start and Continue of the Bullets and Numbering menu of the MTEXT editor: Start numbers the list the first paragraph selected is in again from 1 (or a), Continue numbers it on from the paragraph before (`1. Plate, 2. Beam, 3. Column` with Start on Beam is `1. Plate, 1. Beam, 2. Column`, and Continue puts it back), one undo step each, grey where the paragraph is in no numbered or lettered list. New public `CadMTextEditor.RenumberList`.
**NEW.** Annotative text: the Text Style dialog has an Annotative box (new public `CadTextStyleSettings.Annotative`, the style's extended data AcadAnnotative, live in a drawing of AutoCAD 2007 or later), and the Annotative button of the Style panel of the MTEXT editor makes an MTEXT being made annotative or not, over what its text style says, at the annotation scale (an MTEXT 2.5 high at 1:50 is 125 on the model); it is ticked at first for an annotative style and grey, saying why, for an MTEXT already made, a table cell and a drawing older than AutoCAD 2007.
**NEW.** The Format of a cell style in the Modify Table Style dialog opens the Table Cell Format dialog and keeps the kind of data, its unit and the format string in the style, per cell style (Data, Header, Title). New public `DxfTableStyle.DataType`, `SetDataType`, `Format` and `SetFormat` (groups 90, 91 and 1 of each cell style, written by a file of AutoCAD 2007 or later; a style starts General, Unitless and with no format) and `CadTableCellStyleSettings.DataType`, `UnitType` and `Format`.
**CHANGED.** CONSTRAINTNAMEFORMAT is acted on: a new dimensional constraint shows the words it asks for, 0 the name (`d1`), 1 the value (`10.0000`), 2 the name and the value (`d1=10.0000`, as before and the default), where every constraint showed the name and the value. A drawing opened takes the format of each constraint from the words its dimension shows, and a value or a name changed keeps it.
**NEW.** WMFOUT in the presenter: AutoCAD 2021's Create WMF File dialog (or `Enter file name <file>:`), `Select objects:`, and the objects selected written as a placeable Windows Metafile of its own writer: the box of the objects 20 000 logical units along its longer side with y down and 1 440 units to the inch, a Polyline with a pen of the object's colour and line weight for each line (0.25 mm is 14 units; a dashed line a pen of no width and the dash or dot style), a PolyPolygon with a solid brush for each fill, an Arial or other TextOut for each TrueType text. White is black, as on a plot. The file is read back by WMFIN. Nothing is selected, nothing is written; no undo step.
**NEW.** PSOUT in the presenter: AutoCAD 2021's questions (read from its resource strings), `What to plot -- Display, Extents, Limits, View, or Window <D>:` with View's name and Window's two corners, `Enter screen preview image type [None/EPSI/TIFF] <None>:` (EPSI and TIFF accepted, no preview written), `Enter size units [Inches/Millimeters] <Inches>:`, `Enter plotted Inches to drawing units (as P=D) or [Fit/? (help)] <F>:` and `Enter the Size or Width,Height (in Inches) <USER>:` (a label of AutoCAD's table, A to K and A4 to A0, the table printed after Fit and by `?`; USER is 7.5 by 10.5 inches), then `Effective plotting area:  7.50 wide by 4.25 high`. The file is Encapsulated PostScript level 2 in vectors, its `%%BoundingBox` the output box: a drawing 180 by 60 at `1=10` in millimetres is `0 0 52 18`. The area and the units are the next defaults.
**NEW.** EXPORT writes Metafile (as WMFOUT), Encapsulated PS (as PSOUT), Block (as -WBLOCK after its file) and DXX Extract (ATTEXT's DXF extract of the blocks selected); Lithography goes on as STLOUT. Only 3D DWF, 3D DWFx, ACIS, IGES and the DGN types are still refused. STLOUT asks `Select solids or watertight meshes:` and answers a 2D selection with AutoCAD's `1 was filtered out` (probed), asking again until Esc, and writes nothing.
**NEW.** SVGOUT in the presenter, a command of its own (AutoCAD 2021 writes no SVG): the file, `Select objects or <all objects and viewports>:`, and an SVG 1.1 file with a viewBox in drawing units, lines as polylines, fills of the even-odd rule and text elements.
**NEW.** LAYWALK in the presenter, AutoCAD 2021's LayerWalk dialog: the layers selected in its list are the only ones shown (every other layer turned off, a frozen one selected thawed), a filter box takes wild cards (`W*,T?IM`), Select Objects picks layers on the canvas, Purge Layers deletes the unused ones selected (`2 layers purged.`), and Restore on exit, ticked at first, puts every layer back when it closes. A drawing of WALL, DOOR and TRIM walked on DOOR shows DOOR's objects alone and has all three as they were once it closes; with Restore on exit cleared the walk stays, one undo step named LAYWALK. New public `CadLayerWalkRequest` and `CadLayerWalkRow`; with no window the command says it has no command line form, as AutoCAD's has none.
**NEW.** LAYTRANS in the presenter, AutoCAD 2021's Layer Translator. Translate From lists the layers of the drawing and Translate To those of the drawing and of the standards files loaded with Load… (a `.dws`, `.dwg`, `.dwt` or `.dxf`, read by the library's own readers), New… adds one; Map, Map same, Edit… (colour, linetype, lineweight, transparency, plot style of one mapping), Remove and Save… (a `.dws`, a DWG that keeps the mappings as the XRECORD `GH_LAYTRANS_MAP`, which Load reads back) make and keep the mappings; Settings… has the six switches (Force object color, linetype and transparency to ByLayer, Translate objects in blocks, Write transaction log, Show layer contents when selected). Translate puts every object of each layer translated, in model space, the layouts, the blocks and the attributes, on the layer it is mapped to, makes or restyles the layer (the linetype copied from the standards file), deletes the old layers but 0, Defpoints and any layer another mapping goes to, and writes `plan.log` beside `plan.dxf`: 40 lines on OLD-WALL and 12 on OLD-DOOR, mapped to WALL and DOOR, are 52 lines on WALL and DOOR in one undo step. The Manage tab's Layer Translator button, greyed before, runs it. New public `CadLayerTranslatorRequest`, `CadTranslateLayer`, `CadLayerMapping`, `CadLayerTranslatorSettings` and `CadLayerEditor.Translate`; a name ending in .dws is written as a DWG.
**NEW.** DesignCenter in the presenter, as a palette beside the window (ADCENTER, aliases ADC, DC and DCENTER, ADCCLOSE, and a key given ADCENTER: Ctrl+2 stays the DRAWINGS list, and no ribbon button is made yet). Folders, Open Drawings and History tabs over a tree of folders, drawings and their nine kinds of content (Blocks, Dimstyles, Layers, Layouts, Linetypes, Multileaderstyles, Tablestyles, Textstyles, Xrefs), the content listed with pictures of blocks and drawings, a preview and a description. A double click, the right-click menu or a drag onto the canvas inserts a block (INSERT with the file and the block chosen, the Blocks palette for the options, or at the drop point), copies layers, linetypes, text, dimension, multileader and table styles, block definitions and layouts into the drawing as one undo step, keeping what the drawing has by the name (a layer brings its linetype, a dimension style its text style, linetypes and arrowhead blocks), attaches an external reference or inserts a drawing file as a block. New public `CadDesignCenter.Add`, `CadDesignCenterDrawing`, `CadDesignCenterItem`, `CadDesignCenterKind` and `CadDesignCenterResult`; `DesignCenterViewModel` and `MainViewModel.ToggleDesignCenter` in the window.
**NEW.** Tool palettes in the presenter (TOOLPALETTES, alias TP, TOOLPALETTESCLOSE, the Manage tab's Tool Palettes button, greyed before, and a key given TOOLPALETTES: Ctrl+3 stays the ribbon's), as a window beside the drawing with a tab for each palette along its right edge. A palette lists block, hatch and command tools, lines of text and separators as icons, icons with names or rows (View Options: the icon size 16 to 96, for one palette or all). A click runs a tool: a command tool its command line (`CIRCLE 0,0 50` draws the circle at once), a hatch tool HATCH with its pattern, angle and scale, a block tool INSERT with its block, drawing, scale and rotation (the scale and rotation asked where it prompts for them), each with the layer, colour, linetype and lineweight of its Tool Properties current while it runs and the drawing's own put back after, Esc included; a layer the drawing lacks is made in the undo step of the command. A block or hatch tool dragged onto the canvas places the block or hatches the area at the drop point. Objects selected and dragged out of the canvas onto a palette become tools (a block reference a block tool, a hatch a hatch tool, a line, circle, polyline, text or dimension a command tool of the object's layer, colour and linetype), as do blocks dragged from DesignCenter, whose right-click menu gains Create Tool Palette of Blocks. The right-click menus cut, copy, paste, delete, rename and give properties to a tool (the Tool Properties dialog) and make, rename, delete, import and export palettes, add text and separators. The palettes are kept in `ToolPalettes.json` beside the settings (documented in the presenter guide, an exported palette is the same format, `.ghtp`), and a window with no file starts with six palettes of the presenter's own: Draw, Modify, Annotation, Hatches (ANSI31 to ANSI38, solid, gradient, materials), Architectural Hatches and ISO Hatches; no file or icon of AutoCAD's is read. Docking, auto-hide, transparency and the CUSTOMIZE dialog for palette groups are not built. New public `CadToolPalettes`, `CadToolPalette`, `CadTool`, `CadToolKind`, `CadToolViewStyle` and `CadCommandSession.StartTool`; the registry holds 337 commands.
**NEW.** LIMITS in the presenter, as AutoCAD 2021's console asks it (probed): `Reset Model space limits:`, `Specify lower left corner or [ON/OFF] <0.0000,0.0000>:`, `Specify upper right corner <12.0000,9.0000>:`, `Invalid limits.` and the two questions again where the upper right corner is not above and right of the lower left; both limits are one undo step. ON and OFF set LIMCHECK, and with LIMCHECK on a point given to a command that draws, inserts, moves or copies outside the limits is refused with `**Outside limits` and asked again, clicked or typed (`CadLimits`); a point on the limit is inside, and DIST, ZOOM and the windows of a selection are never refused.
**NEW.** TIME in the presenter: `Current time:`, Created, Last updated, Total editing time, the user's Elapsed timer and Next automatic save in (`<no modifications yet>` until the drawing has a change, then SAVETIME minutes counting down) in AutoCAD's columns, a time as `Tuesday, November 17, 2026  8:34:00:000 AM` and a span as `0 days 00:09:59:999`, then `Enter option [Display/ON/OFF/Reset]:` (`Timer off.`, `Timer on.`, `Timer reset to zero.`). The variables TDCREATE, TDUCREATE, TDUPDATE, TDUUPDATE, TDINDWG and TDUSRTIMER read the times as Julian dates or days to eight places, read only, and USRTIMER is the timer's switch.
**NEW.** STATUS in the presenter, AutoCAD 2021's report (probed): the count of objects and the file, the limits with `(Off)` where LIMCHECK is off, what the space uses with `**Over` on the corner outside the limits, what the display shows, the insertion base, the snap resolution and grid spacing, the current space, layout, layer, colour (`BYLAYER -- 7 (white)`), linetype, material, lineweight, elevation and thickness, `Fill on  Grid off  Ortho off  Qtext off  Snap off  Tablet off`, the object snap modes and the free disk space. The undo file size and the memory lines are not written.
**NEW.** FILL and QTEXT in the presenter (`Enter mode [ON/OFF] <ON>:`), one undo step each. FILL off draws a SOLID, a trace, a wide polyline and a solid or gradient hatch by its outline; QTEXT on draws each text, MTEXT and attribute as the box that holds its lines (`DisplayText2.IsQuick`, drawn by the canvas in the colour of the text's line), the words and the grips kept. `$QTEXTMODE` joins `$FILLMODE` among the header settings that draw every space again.
**NEW.** MULTIPLE in the presenter: `Enter command name to repeat:`, then the command started again each time it ends, with its own prompts, until Esc; `Unknown command "FOO".  Press F1 for help.` for a name that is none, and a command that ends having asked nothing or by an error ends the repetition.
**NEW.** TRACE in the presenter: `Specify trace width <0.0500>:` (nought allowed, below nought `Value must be positive.`, the width kept as `$TRACEWID`), `Specify start point:`, `Specify next point:` until Enter. Each segment is a four-cornered SOLID of the width, joined to the next in a mitre as AutoCAD's TRACE joins them (a width of 3 from (0, 0) to (100, 0) to (100, 50) gives the corners (0, 1.5), (0, -1.5), (98.5, 1.5), (101.5, -1.5) and (98.5, 1.5), (101.5, -1.5), (98.5, 50), (101.5, 50), the ends of the path square); AutoCAD writes TRACE entities, the presenter SOLIDs with the same corners.
**NEW.** SKETCH in the presenter: `Type = Lines  Increment = 0.1000  Tolerance = 0.5000` and `Specify sketch or [Type/Increment/toLerance]:` with AutoCAD's three options, ranges and refusals (probed). A point puts the pen down, the cursor records a point each increment, and Enter lifts the pen, making lines (one for each piece), one polyline or one spline as SKPOLY 0, 1 or 2 says; the variables SKETCHINC (header, undoable), SKPOLY and SKTOLERANCE (`Requires an integer between 0 and 2.`, `Cannot set SKTOLERANCE to that value.`) are set and read. The pen is lifted with Enter, where AutoCAD lifts it with a click.
**NEW.** MASSPROP for regions in the presenter: `Select objects:`, then AutoCAD 2021's report for the regions together (area, perimeter, bounding box, centroid, moments of inertia, product of inertia, radii of gyration, principal moments and their directions about the centroid) to the four places it writes, checked against its console for a rectangle, an L, two boxes and rectangles turned 30, 60 and 100 degrees; the integrals are taken round the boundary by Gauss-Legendre quadrature, a disc exact to about 1E-12 and a hole taken away. `Write analysis to a file? [Yes/No] <N>:` and `Enter file name <plan.mpr>:` write the .mpr text as AutoCAD writes it.
**NEW.** MINSERT in the presenter: `Enter block name or [?]:`, the insertion point, scales and rotation as INSERT asks them, then `Enter number of rows (---) <1>:`, `Enter number of columns (|||) <1>:`, `Enter distance between rows or specify unit cell (---):` and `Specify distance between columns (|||):` (a unit cell of two corners gives both distances), making one `DxfMInsertBlock` that draws, picks and plots as the block at each cell and round-trips through DXF and DWG.
**CHANGED.** EXPLODE of a MINSERT says `1 was minserted.`, as AutoCAD 2021's does, where it said `1 was not able to be exploded.`; the MINSERT stays.
**NEW.** DIMINSPECT and -DIMINSPECT in the presenter. -DIMINSPECT asks `Add inspection data or [Remove] <Add>:`, `Select dimensions:`, `Enter shape option [Round/Angular/None] <Round>:`, `Enter label data or <None>:` and `Enter inspection rate <100%>:` (Remove says `1 of inspection removed`); DIMINSPECT picks the dimensions and shows the Inspection Dimension dialog (Shape, Label, Inspection rate, Remove Inspection). The data is kept as AutoCAD 2021 keeps it, in the extended data of `ACAD_DSTYLE_DIMINSPECT` (the rate as typed, the label, the flags 49 and 50 and 36 for round with a label, angular with a label and none), and the dimension is drawn again with its label, words and rate in a frame with round or pointed ends and dividing lines, the dimension line cut where the frame ends.
**NEW.** SAVEALL and CLOSEALL in the presenter's window: SAVEALL saves every drawing open that has changes, each to its file in the order of the files (a drawing with no file asks its Save As), leaves the drawing shown shown and says `Saved 3 drawings.`; CLOSEALL closes every drawing, asking once for all those with changes not saved, as Close All Drawings of the file list does.
**NEW.** PDF underlays in the library: `DxfPdfUnderlay` (AutoCAD's `PdfReference`, the entity PDFUNDERLAY) and `DxfPdfDefinition` (`PdfDefinition`, PDFDEFINITION, in ACAD_PDFUNDERLAYS of the named object dictionary, found or made by `GetPdfDictionary` and `CreatePdfDictionary`, named by `SuggestName` as `sample - Page_1`), read and written in DXF and in DWG as AutoCAD 2021 lays them out (checked by AutoCAD 2021 reading our DXF and DWG, and by our reader reading its DWG): the corner, the scale along the three sides, the turn (degrees in the file), the normal, the display flags (clip on, shown, monochrome, colours adjusted for the background, clip inverted), the contrast and the fade (0 to 100), and the clip boundary in the page's inches before the scale, two corners stored as the upper left and the lower right as AutoCAD stores them. The page is measured in inches (200 by 100 points are 2.7778 by 1.3889). The classes are listed in CLASSES when one is added; a drawing older than R2010 refuses them.
**NEW.** PDF underlays in the presenter, as AutoCAD 2021 does them, with a PDF reader of the library's own (cross-reference tables and streams, object streams, the Flate, LZW, ASCII85, ASCIIHex and run-length filters; paths, clips, forms, colours in every common space, JPEG and sampled pictures with their masks, optional content, and text as the outlines of an embedded TrueType font, else as words in the font of the name): the page is drawn at its place, scale and turn through the display of the canvas, in the colours its fade, contrast, monochrome and "Adjust colors for background" make on the background, through its clip boundary (PDFCLIP: rectangle, polygon, polyline, inverted), with the layers of the PDF on or off, and with its frame (PDFFRAME). Left out and said once in the log: shadings, tiling patterns, Type 3 fonts, CFF and Type 1 font outlines (their words are drawn in the font of the name), CMYK JPEGs, fax, JBIG2 and JPEG 2000 pictures, and passwords. PDFOSNAP lets the End, Mid and Int snaps find the lines of a PDF.
**NEW.** PDFATTACH and -PDFATTACH, PDFADJUST and -PDFADJUST, PDFCLIP, PDFLAYERS, PDFFRAME, PDFOSNAP, FRAME and -PDFUNDERLAY in the presenter, in the words of AutoCAD 2021's own string table. The Attach PDF Underlay dialog lists the pages of the PDF with thumbnails and their sizes (one or more chosen), the path type, the insertion point, the scale (with the Unit box) and the rotation, each given or asked on the command line; -PDFATTACH asks `Path to PDF file to attach:`, `Enter page number or [?] <1>:`, the point, `Specify scale factor or [Unit] <1>:` and the rotation. PDFLAYERS shows the PDF Layers dialog. -PDFUNDERLAY is the library's typed form of what the External References palette does to a PDF underlay (list, detach, unload, reload, path); the palette lists each page as a row of Type PDF and its Attach PDF… item works.
**NEW.** The contextual PDF Underlay tab, shown while PDF underlays alone are selected: Adjust (Fade, Contrast, Monochrome, Adjust colors for background), Clipping (Create Clipping Boundary, Remove Clipping), Options (Show Underlay, the Frame box, Underlay Layers) and Close PDF Underlay, each value one undo step. The Insert tab's Attach PDF…, Adjust, Underlay Layers and Snap to Underlays, greyed before, run PDFATTACH, PDFADJUST, PDFLAYERS and PDFOSNAP.
**NEW.** Parametric constraints in the presenter, as AutoCAD 2021's Parametric tab has them, for lines, circles, arcs and the straight segments of light polylines. The geometric constraints GCCOINCIDENT (a point and a point, or a point and an object), GCCOLLINEAR, GCCONCENTRIC, GCFIX, GCPARALLEL, GCPERPENDICULAR, GCHORIZONTAL and GCVERTICAL (a line, or 2Points), GCTANGENT, GCSYMMETRIC, GCEQUAL (with Multiple) and GEOMCONSTRAINT ask the prompts AutoCAD's console asks (`Select an object or [2Points] <2Points>:`) and apply the constraint by moving the objects the least way, the first picked held and, of a line, its start; GCSMOOTH asks and says the presenter has no splines to solve. A line of 10 by 1 made horizontal keeps its start and ends at (10, 0); two lines made parallel keep the first. A constraint no place meets with the others is refused with `Constraints cannot be satisfied.`, one they already imply as over-constraining, and each is one undo step. AUTOCONSTRAIN (`Select objects or [Settings]:`) applies the horizontal, vertical, perpendicular, parallel, tangent, coincident, concentric, collinear and equal constraints the objects nearly meet within 0.01 and 1 degree, in the order and with the boxes of the AutoConstrain tab. CONSTRAINTBAR (`Enter an option [Show/Hide/Reset] <Show>:`), DELCONSTRAINT (`n constraint(s) removed`) and the constraint bars drawn beside the objects selected or just constrained, a right click on an icon deleting its constraint, hiding its bar or hiding all. `CadConstraints`, `CadConstraintSolver`, `CadConstraintStore`, `CadConstraintBars` and `CadParameters` are new (`CadConstraintBars`, `CadConstraintSettings`, `CadParameters` and `CadParameterRow` public); `CadDocument.ConstraintBars` and `CadCommandSession.Constraints` are new.
**NEW.** Dimensional constraints in the presenter: DCLINEAR, DCHORIZONTAL, DCVERTICAL, DCALIGNED, DCANGULAR (two lines), DCRADIUS and DCDIAMETER, DIMCONSTRAINT (`Current settings:  Constraint form = Dynamic`), DCCONVERT (an associative linear, aligned, radius or diameter dimension made a constraint, `1 associative dimensions converted`), DCFORM and DCDISPLAY. Each makes a parameter named d1, ang1, rad1 or dia1 and a DIMENSION that shows `d1=10.0000` (on the hidden layer `*ADSK_CONSTRAINTS` in the dynamic form, on the current layer in the annotational one; CCONSTRAINTFORM 0 and 1); a value or an expression typed at `Enter name or value <d1=10>:` moves the objects at once. -PARAMETERS has AutoCAD's options and words (`Enter a parameter option [New/Edit/Rename/Delete/?]:`, `Parameter: d1           Expression: 10                    Value: 10.0000`), an expression may name other parameters and use + - * / ^ %, brackets, pi and sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan (degrees), sqrt, abs, exp, ln, log, floor, ceil, round, min, max and pow, and a change of d1 from 10 to 20 stretches a line from (0, 0) to (10, 0) to (20, 0), as AutoCAD 2021 does. The variables CCONSTRAINTFORM, CONSTRAINTBARDISPLAY, CONSTRAINTBARMODE, CONSTRAINTINFER, CONSTRAINTNAMEFORMAT, DYNCONSTRAINTMODE, CONSTRAINTSOLVEMODE and PARAMETERCOPYMODE and the read-only PARAMETERSSTATUS and CONSTRAINTRELAX are new. Not solved yet: the distance of a point to a line, the angle of three points or of an arc, a smooth constraint, reference dimensions; CONSTRAINTINFER, CONSTRAINTNAMEFORMAT, CONSTRAINTSOLVEMODE and PARAMETERCOPYMODE are kept but not acted on.
**NEW.** A constrained object edited in the presenter (a grip, MOVE, STRETCH, Properties) carries the other objects with it in the same undo step: what the edit placed is held, the rest moves the least way that keeps the constraints (the end of a line given a distance of 10, dragged to x = 15, comes back to x = 10), the edit is taken back with `Constraints cannot be satisfied.` where nothing keeps them, and an object erased takes its constraints and their dimensions with it. The solver (`CadConstraintSolver`) is the presenter's own: the numbers of the objects are the unknowns, each constraint an equation, each step the least weighted change of the linearised equations, brought to 1E-13 and the numbers it did not move put back exactly, the same answer every time.
**NEW.** The Parametric ribbon tab, between Annotate and View: Geometric (Auto Constrain, the twelve constraints, Show All, Hide All, Show/Hide, the launcher opening Constraint Settings), Dimensional (Linear, Aligned, Angular, Radius, Diameter, Convert, Constraint Form, Show Dynamic) and Manage (Delete Constraints, Parameters Manager, Constraint Settings). CONSTRAINTSETTINGS shows the Constraint Settings dialog (Geometric, Dimensional and AutoConstrain tabs) and PARAMETERS the Parameters Manager palette, which lists the name, expression and value of each parameter, edited in the row, with New User Parameter and Delete, each edit one undo step; PARAMETERSCLOSE closes it. `ConstraintSettingsViewModel`, `ParametersPaletteViewModel`, `ParametricRibbonViewModel` and `MainViewModel.ParametricTab` are new, and `--tab Parametric`, `--dialog constraints[:0|1|2]` and `--dialog parameters` work in the screenshot mode. The registry holds 350 commands.
**NEW.** Constraints are kept in a DXF and a DWG as AutoCAD 2021 keeps them: in the associative network of the space's block record an `ACDBASSOC2DCONSTRAINTGROUP` of nodes (the geometry with its implicit points, the constraints, the datum lines), an `ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY` on each object or polyline edge (a polyline gets the vertex ids, group 91, its edges are named by), and for each dimensional constraint an `ACDBASSOCVARIABLE`, an `ACDBASSOCVALUEDEPENDENCY` and an `ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY`. AutoCAD 2021 loaded the files written for horizontal, vertical, parallel, perpendicular, tangent, coincident, collinear, concentric, symmetric, fix and equal constraints, distances, angles, radii and diameters on lines, circles, arcs and a polyline, in DXF and in DWG (AUDIT 0), read each as well defined, and re-solved a parameter set to 20 as the presenter does; it drops a group whose constraints the geometry misses by more than a few digits, which is why the solver finishes to 1E-13. The DWG codec of constraint nodes now writes and reads `AcVerticalConstraint` and `AcSymmetricConstraint`, which left the whole network out of a DWG before.
**NEW.** View in the plot area, in the Plot and Page Setup dialogs, -PLOT and the page setups of the presenter, as AutoCAD 2021 has it. What to plot lists View between Limits (Layout in a layout) and Window, greyed where the drawing has no named view of the space's kind, and View shows a list of the views by name; the plot is the view's window (a view 2 000 wide and 1 000 high about (3 000, 2 000) plots (2 000, 1 500) to (4 000, 2 500)), a twist not applied, the extents where the drawing lacks the view. -PLOT lists `[Display/Extents/Limits/View/Window]` and asks `Enter view name:`, saying `<x> not found.` or `No view specified.  You must enter a view name.` and asking again, as AutoCAD's console does (probed). The page setup keeps it as plot type 3 with the view's name (group 6), in a DXF and in a DWG of R2000 and of R2018. `CadPlotArea.View`, `CadPlotSettings.ViewName` and `ViewNames(document, space)` are new; `DxfPlotSettings.PlotViewName` can now be set.
**CHANGED.** A page setup of plot type 3 (a view) reads as `CadPlotArea.View` where it read as `CadPlotArea.Display`.
**NEW.** The Manage ribbon tab in the presenter, between View and Output, with AutoCAD 2021's panels for what is built: Customization (User Interface, CUI, and Edit Aliases, ALIASEDIT, which open Global settings on Shortcuts; Tool Palettes greyed), Applications (Load Application, APPLOAD, which shows the Plugin manager and is greyed where the window has none; Run Script, SCRIPT) and Cleanup (Purge, Overkill, Audit, Recover); Action Recorder and CAD Standards are parked, their buttons greyed with a tooltip saying so. CUI, ALIASEDIT and APPLOAD are new commands of the window. `ManageRibbonViewModel` and `MainViewModel.ManageTab` are new, and `--tab Manage` and `--tab Output` work in the screenshot mode.
**NEW.** The application menu's search box finds a command by its description as well as its name: "bevel corner" finds CHAMFER and "damaged" finds RECOVER, listed under a rule below the names that hold the text, Enter or a click running the first row or the one clicked. AUTOCOMPLETEDELAY is AutoCAD 2021's alias of the variable INPUTSEARCHDELAY and now types as it does (`Enter new value for INPUTSEARCHDELAY <300>:`); AUTOCOMPLETEMODE already ran -INPUTSEARCHOPTIONS.
**NEW.** More raster types in the presenter, all of AutoCAD 2021's attached by IMAGEATTACH, -IMAGE and the External References palette (AutoCAD's console attached each of them): BMP, DIB (a bitmap with no file header), RLE (run-length coded, 4 or 8 bits), GIF, JPEG, PCX, PNG, TGA and TIFF. The pixels of PNG, JPEG, GIF and BMP are read by the platform; TGA (colour-mapped, true colour and grey, plain or run-length coded, 15 to 32 bits), PCX (1 to 8 bits, planar and with a palette, 24 bits), TIFF (the first image, either byte order, plain, PackBits, LZW, Deflate, and fax coded in modified Huffman, Group 3 and Group 4, in strips or tiles, bilevel to 16 bits, grey, palette, RGB, RGBA and CMYK, the horizontal predictor), DIB and RLE by the presenter's own decoders in `GeometryHelper.Dxf.Viewer` (`CadTgaFile`, `CadPcxFile`, `CadTiffFile`, `CadCcitt`, `CadBmpFile`), with no new package. A picture of 40 by 30 pixels at 254 dots an inch is 4 by 3 mm in any of them, one with no resolution (a TGA) one unit wide. The TIFF reader was checked against files Windows' encoder wrote (LZW, Deflate, PackBits, Group 3, Group 4, a bilevel picture of 2 700 pixels across with every run length of both code tables). A TIFF coded as JPEG, a BigTIFF and floating point samples are attached but drawn as their frames; a picture of more than 16 million pixels is kept as the mean of squares of pixels, so that a scan's thin line stays a grey line. Select Image File lists All image files, then each type.
**NEW.** Bitonal pictures (one bit a pixel: a scanned drawing) are drawn as AutoCAD draws them, in the colour of the image object with the page as the background, which TRANSPARENCY ON lets what is under the image show through; IMAGEADJUST and -IMAGEADJUST refuse them in AutoCAD's words, `Bitonal images cannot be adjusted.`, said once, the others of the selection still adjusted (probed in AutoCAD 2021's console).
**NEW.** IMAGEQUALITY in the presenter (`Enter image quality setting [High/Draft] <High>:`, as AutoCAD 2021's console asks it): High blends the pixels of an image where it is scaled, Draft draws each as a square. Kept in the drawing's RASTERVARIABLES (group 71), one undo step. The command registry holds 311 commands.
**NEW.** The contextual Image tab, shown while images alone are selected: Adjust (Brightness, Contrast, Fade), Clipping (Create Clipping Boundary, Remove Clipping), Options (Show Image, Transparency, the Frame box) and Close Image; each value is one undo step named IMAGEADJUST, TRANSPARENCY, IMAGECLIP or Show image.
**FIXED.** IMAGEFRAME 2 (frames shown and not plotted) drew the frames in a plot as well; they are now left out of a plot and of a PDF.
**NEW.** Dynamic block authoring in the presenter's Block Editor, as AutoCAD 2021's: BPARAMETER (Alignment, Base, pOint, Linear, Polar, Xy, Rotation, Flip, Visibility; the options Name, Label, Chain, Description, Palette and Value set with its None, List and Increment) and BACTION (Array, Flip, Move, Rotate, Scale, sTretch, Polar stretch; Multiplier and Offset) ask AutoCAD's prompts, in the words of its own string table, and write the evaluation graph through the library's writers, one undo step each; a parameter is picked by its glyph (a dimension line with arrowheads and a grip in blue, an action a yellow lightning bolt with its name, drawn by the canvas and picked, selected and erased like an object, ERASE taking a parameter with its grips and actions). A Linear parameter from (0, 0) to (100, 0) with a stretch over the right edge of a rectangle 100 by 50 saved with BSAVE gives each INSERT `Distance1` of 100, and AutoCAD 2021 set it to 300 and stretched the edge to x = 300; 13 blocks (linear with stretch, scale and array, point with move, rotation, flip, XY, polar with polar stretch, visibility, one edited in Properties, one with a parameter erased, one with an object held by an action erased, one with an erased object of a visibility state) saved as DXF and DWG were read by AutoCAD 2021 with the values and geometry the library gives, AUDIT 0 on all 26 files; the 81 dynamic blocks of its own sample drawings open in the editor with their 590 parameters and actions drawn. Not in this version: the Lookup parameter and action, ties to the start point, the corners of an XY parameter, a polygonal stretch frame, a base angle, grips counted 0 to 4, and the Parameter Sets.
**NEW.** BVSTATE, -BVSTATE, BVHIDE and BVSHOW in the presenter (the Visibility States dialog with New, Rename, Delete, Move Up, Move Down and Set Current; `Enter an option [New/Set/Delete] <Set>:`; `Hide for current state or all visibility states [Current/All] <Current>:`): a Visibility parameter starts the block with VisibilityState0 showing every object, a state is added showing none, all or the current state's objects, an object hidden in one state is governed and shown in the others and one hidden in all is kept invisible, the first state is the one an INSERT shows. The editor hides what the state shown does not show, also where no other state shows it (before, only what another state listed was hidden).
**NEW.** The properties of a parameter or an action picked in the Block Editor, as AutoCAD's palette lists them: Name, Show properties, Chain actions, Number of grips (read only), the Geometry rows (read only), the name and description of each property, the Value set rows (type None, List or Increment, minimum, maximum, increment or list; angles in degrees) and for an action its distance multiplier, angle offset, spacings and number of objects; a row set is one undo step and the graph is written in place, and AutoCAD 2021 read a name changed to `Length`, a list of 100, 150, 200 and 300, a description and a multiplier of 0.5 as set.
**NEW.** BAUTHORPALETTE shows the Block Authoring Palettes, a small window with a Parameters and an Actions tab whose tools start BPARAMETER or BACTION with their kind answered (BAUTHORPALETTECLOSE closes it); the Parameter and Action buttons, Visibility States, Make Visible, Make Invisible, Authoring Palettes and Test Block of the Block Editor tab are live. BTESTBLOCK opens the block as it stands, saved or not, alone in a copy of the drawing, as `Test Block Window - DOOR`. The registry holds 318 commands.
**NEW.** The contextual Hatch Creation tab (shown while HATCH or GRADIENT runs, HPDLGMODE 2) and Hatch Editor tab (shown while hatches are selected, other objects selected with them not hiding it) in the presenter, green as the Array tab is, with AutoCAD 2021's panels: Boundaries (Pick Points, Select, Remove, and for a hatch made Recreate and Display Boundary Objects, Retain Boundary Objects), Pattern (the preview and the gallery of the type's patterns or of the nine gradients), Properties (Type, Color, Background, Layer, Transparency, Angle, Scale or Spacing, Double, ISO pen width), Origin (Set Origin, the corners and the middle, Use current origin, Store as default origin), Options (Associative, Annotative, Match Properties, Gap tolerance, Create separate hatches, island detection, Draw order, Hatch Settings) and Close. In the Hatch Creation tab a value is the setting of the next hatch at once (HPNAME, HPANG, HPSCALE and the rest read it) and Close makes the hatch; in the Hatch Editor tab each value is one undo step named HATCHEDIT on every hatch selected, the pattern lines laid again from the origin the hatch has, and the boundary buttons run the commands of AutoCAD's words (a hatch stays selected and its tab stays once the command ends). `HatchTabViewModel` and `MainViewModel.HatchCreationTab`, `HatchEditorTab` and `HatchTab` are new. The Hatch dialog stays for HPDLGMODE 1 and the Hatch Settings button.
**NEW.** HATCHGENERATEBOUNDARY, HATCHSETBOUNDARY and -HATCHEDIT in the presenter, as AutoCAD 2021's console runs them (probed: the prompts, a closed polyline and a CIRCLE on the current layer made from a hatch of two loops, the loops replaced and the hatch left associative, `Hatch boundary associativity removed.`, `Enter type of boundary object [Region/Polyline] <Polyline>:`, `Reassociate hatch with new boundary? [Yes/No] <N>:`). HATCHGENERATEBOUNDARY makes a polyline, or a circle for a whole circle, round each loop of the hatches selected, following nothing. HATCHSETBOUNDARY (`Select hatch object:`, `Select objects to be used for the new boundary:`, `Erase selected linework? [Yes/No] <N>:`) makes the hatch's loops anew from closed objects. -HATCHEDIT has AutoCAD's options DIsassociate, Style, Properties, DRaw order, ADd boundaries, Remove boundaries, recreate Boundary, ASsociate, separate Hatches, Origin, ANnotative, hatch COlor, LAyer and Transparency, each one undo step on every hatch selected. A loop with an ellipse or a spline edge is passed over and said. The variables HPDLGMODE (0 to 2, 2 at first) and HPBOUNDRETAIN (0 or 1) are new.
**CHANGED.** HATCH's Select objects goes back to `Pick internal point or [Select objects/Undo/seTtings]:` after the objects are taken, as AutoCAD's does, where it made the hatch and ended; Enter makes it. HATCH takes `remove Boundaries` and `Origin` without showing them (-HATCH's questions), and keeps the options -HATCH keeps: island detection off, Create separate hatches, retained boundaries and the draw order now apply to HATCH as well as to -HATCH. With HPDLGMODE 1 HATCH shows the Hatch dialog first.
**NEW.** The MTEXT editor's Symbol menu is AutoCAD 2021's in full, twenty-one items in its order (Degrees `%%d`, Plus/Minus `%%p`, Diameter `%%c`, Almost Equal, Angle, Boundary Line, Centerline, Delta, Electrical Phase, Flow Line, Identity, Initial Length, Monument Line, Not Equal, Ohm, Omega, Plate/Property Line, Subscript 2, Squared, Cubed and Non-breaking Space, the rest written as `\U+` codes, "A" and "B" with Ohm between writing `A\U+2126B`), and Other… opens a character map (`CharacterMapViewModel`): the font of the letters at the caret, its characters by character set (Basic Latin is 95 in Arial), Select to gather them in Characters to copy and Copy to put them on the clipboard, for Ctrl+V. Three items were named otherwise before: Degree, Centre Line and Square are now Degrees, Centerline and Squared, as AutoCAD names them.
